source_ref.summary: Materialized from the 2026-04-19 architecture-team input gap matrix for blocked module contracts

review_notes_zh: 審查通過：（1）BFF 合約完整發布 GET controls 與 POST patch 兩條路由，包含 ControlParameter schema、四種 control_type、三種 allowed_range 形式、validation/warning/rejection 語義，以及 updated_controls 作為 backend-owned diff source；（2）screen spec 完整覆蓋五個頁面區塊、狀態表與降級表，與 BFF 合約一致；（3）example payloads JSON 驗證通過，四種回應分支齊全；（4）PACKET_FAMILY.md 與 PANTHEON_FRONTEND_SA.md 均已正確標記為 contract-published / pending-bff。三個 acceptance criteria 全數通過，無需修改。

handoffs.message: TW-02 contract ready for review. Deliverables: (1) docs/bff/TW-02-parameter-controls.md — published GET /api/v1/trainer/sessions/{session_id}/controls and POST /api/v1/trainer/sessions/{session_id}/patch, ControlParameter schema, explicit validation/rejection semantics, allowedActions.canPatchControls, and backend-owned diff shape; (2) docs/screens/TW-02-parameter-controls.md — production screen gate and UI behavior for controls, validation, degradation, and inline diff; (3) docs/examples/TW-02-parameter-controls.json — controls read, success/warning/invalid patch responses, and degraded example; (4) synced docs/pantheon-handoffs/TW-007-trainer-workbench/PACKET_FAMILY.md and docs/lovable/PANTHEON_FRONTEND_SA.md so TW-02 now reads as contract-published / pending-bff instead of blocked. Validation: python3 -m json.tool docs/examples/TW-02-parameter-controls.json

Review approved: all three acceptance criteria pass. Controls and patch routes are published, validation/warning semantics are explicit, and control diffs are backend-owned. Contract is complete and ready for BFF implementation.
